# `Q-5-61` — Twitter Card Image Size Ignored

> `twitter-card` sets `image-width` or `image-height`, which have no effect because Twitter Cards have no image size tags.

## What this means

Open Graph has `og:image:width` and `og:image:height` tags; Twitter
Cards have no equivalent. A size set under `twitter-card` has nowhere
to go, so Quarto ignores it.

## Why this happens

```yaml
website:
  twitter-card:
    image-width: 1200
    image-height: 630
```

## How to fix

Move the size under `open-graph`, or remove it:

```yaml
website:
  open-graph:
    image-width: 1200
    image-height: 630
  twitter-card: true
```

When the image file can be read, Quarto takes the size from the file
and the declared size isn't needed.
